scenes.heading: Evaluating a RAG System
scenes.narration: Let's see how to evaluate a RAG system — because it has two halves that fail for completely different reasons.

scenes.heading: Two halves, two metric families
items: Retrieval: was the right chunk even fetched?
Generation: did the answer use it and stay on topic?
One end-to-end score hides which half broke
Split the metrics to make failures actionable
scenes.narration: RAG failures split cleanly. Either retrieval didn't fetch the right context, or generation had the right context and still answered poorly. A single accuracy number hides which half broke, so you can't tell whether to fix chunking or fix the prompt. Measuring the two halves separately is the first principle of RAG evaluation.

scenes.heading: The metrics that matter
steps: Recall@k: relevant chunk in the top k?
MRR: how high did the first hit land?
Faithfulness: every claim backed by context?
Answer relevance: does it address the question?
scenes.narration: On the retrieval side, recall-at-k asks whether a relevant chunk made the top k, and MRR rewards putting it near the top. On the generation side, faithfulness checks that every claim is supported by the retrieved context, and answer relevance checks it actually addresses the question. Those last two are fuzzy semantic judgments, so you typically hand them to a calibrated LLM-as-judge.

scenes.heading: Scoring retrieval
scenes.narration: Here are the two core retrieval metrics. Recall-at-k is binary: was any gold chunk anywhere in the top k? Reciprocal rank is stricter — it scores one over the rank of the first hit. So a gold chunk at position three counts as a full recall hit but only a point-three-three reciprocal rank, capturing the ordering that recall ignores.

scenes.text: Build a labeled eval set once, score both halves, and gate CI on per-metric thresholds so a tweak can't silently regress quality.
scenes.narration: The payoff is a labeled eval set you build once and wire into CI with per-metric thresholds. Watch for high faithfulness with low recall — that means the model faithfully answered a wrongly-retrieved chunk, a failure only the split metrics expose.
